result.subject: Reminder: RSVP for Q1 ExCo offsite
result.body:
Hi all,

Just a friendly reminder about the Q1 ExCo offsite on Wednesday 13 January at Hartwell Manor, Surrey. Please let us know by Monday 30 November whether you’ll be joining us (yes or no) so we can meet the venue’s final numbers deadline of Tuesday 15 December. If you’re coming, kindly include any dietary restrictions or accessibility needs. Your quick reply helps us plan a great day for everyone.

Thanks,
Business Operations
